rows.note: This is the all-purpose Cantonese word for the metric unit of mass, especially in everyday speech.

example.english: This truck is carrying a ton of goods.
example.jyutping: ne1 gaa3 fo3 ce1 zoi3 zyu6 jat1 deon1 fo3

rows.note: Use this before a noun such as 工作 when “a ton of” means a very large amount rather than a literal weight.

example.english: I still have a ton of work left to do.
example.traditional: 我仲有一大堆工作未做。
example.jyutping: ngo5 zung6 jau5 jat1 daai6 deoi1 gung1 zok3 mei6 zou6
